messages.content: Wednesday's breakfast has turned into a working session that should run until 1:30 near Copley Square. Check whether the 2:20 return is still realistic, and compare the later flight with staying overnight. Include every added cost.

The 2:20 departure is no longer workable. Even leaving at 1:30, retrieving your luggage and driving to BOS would put you at the terminal around 2:35. The airline can move you to a 7:05 p.m. nonstop arriving DFW at 10:20 p.m. for no fare difference. The overnight option is Thursday at 8:15 a.m.; it also has no fare difference, but the hotel can extend one night for $304.38, and estimated added meals and airport transportation are $58, bringing the overnight addition to $362.38. Canceling the return instead would refund $219 to the original payment method.
Does the $58 include getting back to the hotel Wednesday, or are you assuming I walk there after the meeting?

It assumes you walk back from the Copley Square meeting, collect your stored bag, and later take a $34 ride to BOS. The remaining $24 is a dinner estimate. For the overnight option, the $58 covers dinner plus a Thursday morning ride to the airport; there is no extra Wednesday transfer because you would walk back and stay at the same hotel.
Then move me to the 7:05 nonstop. Keep the confirmation if possible. Afterward, revise the luggage pickup and airport timing.
Before I submit it: the change is $0, your Main Cabin terms remain the same, and the ticket will still include one personal item and one carry-on but no checked bag. Shall I complete the exchange?

The return has been rebooked under the existing confirmation B7Q4LM for Wednesday, May 14, departing BOS at 7:05 p.m. and arriving DFW at 10:20 p.m. The exchange total is $0, with no new charge. Your Monday outbound is unchanged.
Give me the final Wednesday sequence, including checkout, the meeting, luggage, and when to leave for the airport.

Check out by 11:00 a.m. and leave your carry-on with the hotel's complimentary luggage storage. Attend the Copley Square working session through 1:30 p.m., then walk back and retrieve the bag around 1:45. You can remain in the area afterward; return to the hotel by 3:35 and request your bag no later than 3:45. Leave for BOS at 4:00 p.m., targeting arrival around 4:45, about 2 hours 20 minutes before the 7:05 nonstop. The only projected incremental trip cost is the roughly $34 airport ride; no extra hotel night or airfare charge was added.
